visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Operands Popped in the Wrong Order
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The expression 23*54*+9- equals 17, but the program prints -17.

solution.explanation: The right operand was pushed last, so it is popped first. Popping into a first swaps the roles of the two operands, which does not matter for + and * but turns 26 - 9 into 9 - 26.
